_comment: Database schema registry. Grouped by app/lib. Updated by sdd-architect (on design) and sdd-implementor-back (on migration). Source of truth for all tables.

_schema._app_keys: Use the app directory name as key. E.g. 'example-api'. Frontend apps don't have DB tables.

_update_protocol.create: Set created_in_cycle: N, updated_in_cycle: null, changelog: []. Add migration_file with Flyway format V{N}__create_{table}.sql.
_update_protocol.add_column: Set updated_in_cycle: N, add column to columns object, add migration_file V{N}__alter_{table}_add_{col}.sql, append to changelog.
_update_protocol.alter_column: Set updated_in_cycle: N, update column definition, add migration file, append to changelog.
_update_protocol.deprecate_table: Set status: deprecated, do NOT delete entry — add to changelog with change: 'table deprecated — reason'

TableEntry.spec: path a la spec que lo originó
TableEntry.created_in_cycle: número de ciclo donde se diseñó por primera vez
TableEntry.updated_in_cycle: número del último ciclo que lo modificó (null si nunca se actualizó)
TableEntry.migration_file: archivo Flyway más reciente que afecta esta tabla
